name: darkmode
description: Dark/light mode switching with FOUC prevention. Uses data-theme attribute on <html> element (not body). Three values: light | dark | auto (follows OS). Persistent via localStorage key 'mdf-theme'. Sub-themes only need to define CSS variables for [data-theme='dark'].

params.description: Default theme when no localStorage preference. Values: 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto'
params.effect: Sets initial theme before user interacts with toggle

css_convention.note: Sub-theme must define both :root and [data-theme='dark'] blocks in main.css

css.note: No standalone CSS file. Dark mode styles are defined in sub-theme main.css via [data-theme='dark'] CSS variables.

js.note: Toggle logic: reads/writes localStorage 'mdf-theme', sets html[data-theme]. Never modify.

assets.size_impact: ~1KB local JS (deferred). FOUC prevention script is inline in <head> (~300B).

locked.reason: darkmode.js reads #mdf-theme-toggle and writes html[data-theme]. theme-init.html also writes html[data-theme]. Changing these breaks the contract.

css_in_main.note: Sub-theme MUST define [data-theme='dark'] CSS variable overrides in main.css

partials.note: Override to empty to disable dark mode entirely. Keep IIFE structure if customizing.
Override to empty to hide the toggle button. Keep #mdf-theme-toggle id if customizing.
